title: Reset your Kestrel Cloud password
text: Open the Kestrel Cloud sign-in page and choose Forgot password. We email a reset link that works for 30 minutes.

title: Find and download invoices
text: Invoices are under Billing in the Kestrel Cloud console. Each one can be downloaded as a PDF once the billing month closes.

title: Create and rotate API keys
text: Create an API key under Settings, then API keys. Rotate it by creating a second key, switching your integration over and deleting the old one.

title: Check service status
text: Live service status and past incidents are published on the Kestrel Cloud status page. Subscribe there for email updates.

title: Export your workspace data
text: Workspace owners can request a full export under Settings, then Data. The export is ready within one working day.
